record.question: Vangchhia became Mizoram's first archaeological protected site in the year:
record.explanation: Answer D: 2014. The final ASI notification for Menhirs and Caves at Vangchhia is dated 17 February 2014, so 2014 is the year the site was formally notified as protected. Earlier reports mention approval in 2012; the question asks when it became protected, for which the notification date is the clearer criterion. Reference: https://asiguwahaticircle.gov.in/VANGCHHIA.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
